data.value: PDFs & templates: 20MB. Images: 1MB. Attachments: 10MB. Request body limit: 40MB. Larger requests return “Request exceeded limit”.

data.name: ApiDocsAbuseDescription

data.name: ApiDocsHelp

data.name: ApiDocPresignPurpose
data.value: Prepare PDF and return hash to sign

data.name: ApiDocPresignMeta
data.value: Prepare a PDF for external signing and get back the hash to sign. The private key never leaves your device — Performance4PDF only ever sees the hash.

data.name: ApiDocPresignIntro
data.value: Starts the two-step signing flow. Performance4PDF embeds a signature placeholder in the PDF, computes the digest over the signed byte ranges, and returns it. You sign that digest wherever the key lives — smart card, HSM, browser WebCrypto — and finish with /api/sign. The private key is never uploaded.

data.name: ApiDocPresignNote1
data.value: Free — no credit is charged until the signature is finalised with /api/sign.

data.name: ApiDocSignMeta
data.value: Complete a two-step PDF signature by submitting the externally signed hash. Returns the finished PDF with an embedded PKCS#7 detached signature.

data.name: ApiDocSignIntro
data.value: Second half of the external signing flow. Send back the id from /api/presign together with the signature you produced over the returned hash; Performance4PDF injects it into the reserved placeholder and returns the finished document.

data.name: ApiDocSignPfxMeta
data.value: Sign a PDF in one call using a PKCS#12 (PFX/P12) certificate. One request in, signed PDF out — no two-step flow.

data.name: ApiDocSignPfxIntro
data.value: All-in-one signing for server-side workflows where the certificate lives on the server anyway. Supply the PDF and the PKCS#12 file and Performance4PDF handles the whole signature in a single round trip. If you would rather not upload the key at all, use the presign flow instead.

data.name: ApiDocTimestampMeta
data.value: Add a trusted RFC 3161 timestamp to a PDF from any TSA. Proves the document existed at a point in time, no signing certificate required.

data.name: ApiDocTimestampIntro
data.value: Applies a timestamp from an RFC 3161 timestamping authority without signing the document with a personal certificate. Useful on its own as proof of existence, or combined with a signature for long-term validation.

data.name: ApiDocAttachmentMeta
data.value: Embed any file inside a PDF as an attachment via API — invoices with XML payloads, terms, supporting documents.

data.name: ApiDocAttachmentIntro
data.value: Attaches an arbitrary file to a PDF so the two travel as one document. Common for hybrid invoice formats where a machine-readable payload rides along inside the human-readable PDF.

data.name: ApiDocConvertPdfaMeta
data.value: Convert PDFs to PDF/A for archiving via API. Supports PDF/A-1, PDF/A-2, PDF/A-3 and PDF/A-4 conformance levels.

data.name: ApiDocConvertPdfaIntro
data.value: Converts a document to the PDF/A archival profile, which is what most records-retention and public-sector rules require. Defaults to PDF/A-2B.

data.name: ApiDocConvertPdfaNote1
data.value: Costs 1 credit per started 3 pages. Defaults to PDF/A-2B.

data.name: ApiDocConvertPdfaNote2
data.value: Conformance options: PDF/A-1A, PDF/A-1B, PDF/A-2A, PDF/A-2B, PDF/A-2U, PDF/A-3A, PDF/A-3B, PDF/A-3U, PDF/A-4, PDF/A-4E, PDF/A-4F.

data.name: ApiDocFillPdfTitle
data.value: Fill a PDF template with data

data.name: ApiDocFillPdfMeta
data.value: Generate PDFs from a template and JSON data via API. One request produces a batch of filled documents — invoices, contracts, certificates.

data.name: ApiDocFillPdfIntro
data.value: Renders a stored template into finished documents. Pass one data set per output and the response carries one PDF per set, so a whole batch costs a single round trip.

data.name: ApiDocFillPdfNote1
data.value: Costs 1 credit per started 3 pages per generated output (dataset).

data.name: ApiDocFindCodesTitle
data.value: Find barcodes and QR codes in a PDF

data.name: ApiDocFindCodesMeta
data.value: Extract QR codes, DataMatrix, PDF417 and Aztec barcodes from a PDF via API, with the page number and position of every hit.

data.name: ApiDocFindCodesIntro
data.value: Scans every page for machine-readable codes and returns their decoded value, type, page and position — enough to route or reconcile a document automatically.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateCreatePurpose
data.value: Store a PDF with named field positions

data.name: ApiDocTemplateCreateMeta
data.value: Create a reusable PDF template over the API: upload the PDF and define named fields at fixed positions, then fill it with data later.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateCreateIntro
data.value: A template is a PDF plus named fields at fixed positions. Create one here and generate documents from it with /api/fill-pdf. Both pdfContent and at least one field are required. Managing templates is free — you are only charged when you render.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateCreateNote1
data.value: Field types: text, image, signature, barcode, table. Coordinates use the PDF origin (bottom-left).

data.name: ApiDocTemplateCreateNote2
data.value: Returns 400 when fields is empty or pdfContent is missing.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateListMeta
data.value: List every PDF template stored on your account, with its id, name, creation date and field count.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateListIntro
data.value: Returns the templates belonging to the authenticated account. Summaries only — the PDF itself is not included, so this stays cheap to poll. Fetch a single template to get its contents.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateGetPurpose
data.value: Read one template with its PDF and fields

data.name: ApiDocTemplateGetMeta
data.value: Retrieve a single PDF template by id, including the stored PDF as base64 and the full field definitions.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateGetIntro
data.value: Returns one template in full: the base64 PDF and every field definition. This is what a template editor loads to render the document with its field overlays.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateGetNote1
data.value: Templates are scoped to the account that created them; another account's id returns an error.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateUpdatePurpose
data.value: Change a template's PDF, fields or name

data.name: ApiDocTemplateUpdateMeta
data.value: Update a stored PDF template — replace its PDF, redefine its fields, or rename it. Send only the parts you want to change.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateUpdateIntro
data.value: Partial update: send only what changes. Supplying fields replaces the whole field list rather than merging, so send the complete set. At least one of pdfContent, fields or templateName must be present.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateUpdateNote1
data.value: Returns 400 when the body carries no change at all.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateDeleteMeta
data.value: Delete a stored PDF template by id. Permanent — documents already generated from it are unaffected.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateDeleteIntro
data.value: Removes the template and its stored PDF. Documents already generated from it are unaffected. Returns 204 with no body on success.

data.name: ApiDocTemplateDeleteNote1
data.value: Permanent — there is no undo. Fill requests referencing the id will fail afterwards.
